# Glitch Grow — the AI Digital Marketing Stack

> Six production AI agents (ads, sales, social, voice, SEO, UGC creative) — the full AI digital marketing stack for agencies, freelancers, and marketing operators. Each agent plugs into any AI coding agent — Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, NemoClaw, Cursor — anything that reads AGENTS.md and runs shell commands. Buy once at $499 (AI Digital Marketing Stack bundle) or per-agent from $99, run on your own infrastructure, white-label and resell to clients at $1,497–$2,997/mo per service line. One-time payment, BSL 1.1 source-available licence, no subscription.

Glitch Grow is a product of Glitch Executor Labs (Toronto, Canada). Each agent ships as a source-available repo (BSL 1.1) plus an installable MCP that drops into Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, NemoClaw, Cursor — anything that reads AGENTS.md. Deploy configs (Docker, systemd, GCE cloud-init, Cloud Run, nginx), brand-config schema, and a resale playbook are included. Buyers receive private Codeberg collaborator access on purchase. Stripe (USD global) and Razorpay (INR India) payment rails. 14-day refund.

The pitch: digital-marketing agencies pay $5,760+/yr stacking Zapier + Make + AdEspresso + Madgicx + Smartlead + voice/SaaS tools to deliver one client. The AI Digital Marketing Stack replaces that recurring spend with one bundled purchase of production agents already running real businesses. Margin arbitrage is the resale model — charge clients $1.5K–$3K/mo for a managed AI digital marketing service while running it on $40–$150/mo of infra you control.

## Agents (one-line summaries)

- [AI Ads Agent](https://grow.glitchexecutor.com/products/ads-agent): Autonomous ads-ops MCP for Meta + Google + TikTok with Telegram/Discord HITL approvals. Sell as $1,497/mo per managed brand.
- [AI Sales Agent](https://grow.glitchexecutor.com/products/sales-agent): Outbound discovery → enrichment → drafting → Discord-approve → send loop, exposed as an AI-coding-agent MCP. Sell as $797/mo Studio outbound.
- [AI Social Media Agent](https://grow.glitchexecutor.com/products/social-media-agent): Multi-brand social ops across 10+ platforms via Upload-Post + AI video pipeline (Kling 2.0). Sell at $1,497/mo per brand.
- [Voice AI Agent](https://grow.glitchexecutor.com/products/cod-confirm): LiveKit + Sarvam STT (10 Indian languages) + GPT-4o-mini + ElevenLabs TTS. $0.02/min raw infra cost beats Bland.ai 5×.
- [AI SEO Agent](https://grow.glitchexecutor.com/products/seo-agent): SEO + AI-search MCP — audits, schema, llms.txt, internal-link planner, Shopify metafields. Sell at $1,497/mo per site.
- [AI UGC Agent](https://grow.glitchexecutor.com/products/ugc-agent): Production UGC video ad pipeline — brief → 5–8 hook variants → HeyGen + ElevenLabs + b-roll → Meta/TikTok Ads draft. Replaces $7K+/mo specialist UGC agency retainers.

## Who it's for

- Digital marketing agencies wanting to add an AI service line without building from scratch
- Freelancers expanding into productized managed AI marketing services
- Indie developers shipping vertical AI marketing tools
- D2C / Shopify operators who want their marketing stack driven by their AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, NemoClaw, Cursor) instead of stitched together from 5+ SaaS subscriptions
- Anyone tired of paying $5K+/yr to assemble what used to be one agency-tier stack

## How buyers use the agents

Each agent is an MCP server. Buyer installs any AI coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, OpenClaw, Hermes, NemoClaw, Cursor), pastes our install line, and tells Claude what to do in plain English:

  "Scale my winning Meta ad by 20% and refresh the audience" → AI Ads Agent
  "Find 50 dental clinics in Bangalore and draft outreach"   → AI Sales Agent
  "Post the launch announcement to LinkedIn, X, TikTok"      → AI Social Media Agent
  "Start COD calls for orders 4011–4019"                     → Voice AI Agent
  "Audit my-store.com and ship schema + llms.txt updates"    → AI SEO Agent
  "Generate 5 hook variants for my new whey protein launch"  → AI UGC Agent

The AI coding agent orchestrates the agent's tools — encoded workflows that run multi-step, approval-gated, agency-tier work. Not raw API endpoints.
